name: Kayseri jewellery-shop thief, 2026 (convicted at first instance; silhouette only)
depiction: The 26-year-old man a Kayseri court sentenced in May 2026 to nine years and seven months for the February 2026 forklift raid on a jewellery shop and the getaway on a donkey (named only by initials in Turkish reports). Drawn ONLY as a dark rim-lit silhouette (silhouette option): no face, no features; plain dark hooded jacket. Never named. Not a likeness. Tagged NOT A LIKENESS. No weapon; the donkey is drawn calm and unhurt.
